name: dskripchenko/php-docx
description: The HTML layer for PHPWord pipelines and a standalone DOCX-HTML round-trip library: read arbitrary Word/Google Docs/LibreOffice/PHPWord documents to a typed AST and clean HTML, convert HTML to DOCX, detect MERGEFIELD/content-control/{{placeholder}} template variables. Pure PHP, zero dependencies.

suggest.tijsverkoyen/css-to-inline-styles: Enables Converter::fromHtmlWithStyles() — inlines <style> blocks and CSS classes before HTML conversion (^2.2)
